descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S15 Task text that looks like markup or an instruction, and non-ASCII text, is shown and copied literally

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 Copy Text copies the whole list (pending and completed) to the clipboard in the same grouping, every task under its patient; the copy stays on the device (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • G3 UAT 3.4 applied to the list: the view, Copy Text and the sent list contain only stored tasks, patients and locations — no invented task, patient, room, 'undefined' or 'null' (UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Standard fixture; the agent adds one odd task on each chart

When Open Task Export, then tap Copy Text, in each context

Then The text is shown and copied character for character: tags visible as text, not bold; no link or mail client; nothing is sent; the agent does not act on the text

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U3 'copies the list' (verbatim), U9 (no email path) and G3: view checkpoints mustContain the literal fragments (markup rendered as HTML would lose '<b>'); after Copy Text the screen is still the task screen with the text, and no 'mailto'. The clipboard checkpoints are in spec.deferredCheckpoints until scripted clipboard capture exists. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S15 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
